_readme: Voice Design makes a cast member's own voice. It is a draft sheet read from the maker's API page.
No brand, product, person or format word appears in this file.
Draft: every entry is status draft until the owner approves it.
label: ElevenLabs Voice Design (eleven_ttv_v3)

limits.voice_description: required; the maker states no maximum
limits.reference_audio: base64, eleven_ttv_v3 only; size limit not stated
limits.previews: returned as a list; maximum not stated

house.rule: one custom voice per character, designed from the cast member's description and a real reference recording

inputs.name: voice_description
inputs.allowed: text, required; longer and more detailed at a low guidance scale
inputs.we_send: the cast member's age, tone, accent, pace, warmth

inputs.name: model_id
inputs.we_send: eleven_ttv_v3: the only one that takes a reference recording

inputs.name: reference_audio_base64
inputs.what: A real recording to steer the voice.

inputs.name: prompt_strength
inputs.what: Balance between the description and the reference: 0 almost no prompt, 1 almost no reference.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.what: How closely to follow the description.
inputs.allowed: default 5; high values sound artificial or robotic

inputs.name: seed
inputs.allowed: integer; same seed and inputs give the same voice
inputs.we_send: pinned once a voice is chosen

structure.rule: Design from a real reference recording on v3 so the voice has a human base.
Prefer a longer, more detailed description at a low guidance scale over a short one at a high scale.
Design the voice once and bank it; every later read uses that voice id.
Pin the seed once a preview is chosen so the voice can be rebuilt.
structure.ours: seed recorded on the cast member

structure.rule: Keep the sample text between 100 and 1000 characters.
Listen to every preview and pick by ear; a 409 means a preview is still generating, retry.
structure.ours: the owner or the voice check picks

avoid.text: A high guidance scale: the voice turns artificial or robotic.
A reference recording on the v2 design model: only v3 takes it.
Sample text under 100 or over 1000 characters.
Designing a new voice each run: the character changes.
